_doc: /china search (docs/briefs/CHINA_SEARCH.md, decision 088). routes: forwarder x mode shown for China (owner's spec 2026-11-09). assumed_kg: weight used when the page lists none (said in UPPERCASE). top_per_site: results shown per site. Ranking: most trusted first (china/trust.py score: seller, guarantees, store age, certificates, sales, reviews, rating, complaint kinds, spec mismatch), price only within a band of 5 points (decision 092). suspicious_ratio: a listing whose item price is below this share of the search's median item price is marked suspiciously cheap and never picked. claude_model: model for browsing runs (cheaper than the default to save Max quota). site_timeout_s: per site. keep_last_hours: /china last. taobao_mode: 'link' = no reading, the answer gives a Taobao search link (owner, 2026-11-09: Taobao's phone/slider check after QR login fails in the bot's browser and is never bypassed); 'profile' = read in .browser/taobao once a sign-in there works. brands: per category, 'trusted' brands add +10 and 'lookalike' brands -30 to the trust score; each entry is the brand's spellings (Chinese first). Matched on the 品牌 spec, a brand store's name or the start of the title only (decision 093). Owner-editable: add brands you trust, and look-alikes you meet (e.g. 'UE', seen 2026-11-09 imitating Ugreen).
